component: Unified toolbar Chat visibility and saved layout

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The preference CSS hides the live Chat button and customization tiles while itemIds still collects every target child. The test configures three spaces and checks visibility before and after disabling Chat, but does not assert restored visibility or later persistence. Review withdrew permanent state removal; this is a visibility change, not a layout migration or evidence that dirty-state and position concerns disappeared. No live preference or rendering run occurred.
title: Disabled Chat is hidden without deleting its toolbar layout entries
